snippet.title: Leviathan ~A Survival RPG~ - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Leviathan is a Survival Adventure RPG that takes place on a near inescapable island that's guarded by a dragon called the Leviathan. It's up to the player to try to find a way to escape the island and defeat the dragon while using all the resources on the island at their disposal.

Buy it on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2SqRsCu

Kagura Games on Steam:
http://bit.ly/2SibPSb

Developer: TechnoBrake
Publisher: Kagura Games
